widgets.label: Attitude
widgets.description: Artificial horizon with a heading readout. Bind roll, pitch and heading, in that order, in degrees.

widgets.label: Bar Gauge
widgets.description: Bar with a scale, limit colours and a target marker. Can read downward, for depth.

widgets.label: Battery
widgets.description: Battery card: charge level, time remaining, voltage, current, temperature, swap.

widgets.label: Beacon
widgets.description: Beacon card: output, frequency, level, pattern and timing.

widgets.label: Command Button
widgets.description: Runs an engine command. Commands marked danger need a 0.8 s hold.

widgets.label: Camera
widgets.description: Live camera view with target tracking, arm/disarm and calibration.

widgets.label: Trend Chart
widgets.description: Scrolling trend of several channels. Supports a log scale.

widgets.label: Diagram
widgets.description: Live system diagram from the app: units, switches, readouts and animated links.

widgets.label: Gauge
widgets.description: Arc gauge with limit bands. Large adds ticks and a trend.

widgets.label: Heater
widgets.description: Heater card: on/off, temperature, warm-up, ready state and inhibit fault.

widgets.label: Indicator
widgets.description: Lamp for a status bit or a state like OK / LOCKED / TRIPPED.

widgets.label: Joystick
widgets.description: Two-axis stick. Bind two writable numbers: left/right, then forward/back. Springs back to centre.

widgets.label: Event Log
widgets.description: Live feed of who did what, alerts and engine events.

widgets.label: Track Map
widgets.description: Top-down map of one or more vehicles with their trails. Bind channels in groups of three: x, y and heading for each vehicle. Waypoints come from a text channel holding a JSON list of [x, y].

widgets.label: Mode Selector
widgets.description: Segmented selector for a writable state channel.

widgets.label: Motor
widgets.description: Motor card for a wheel, rotor or propeller: start/stop, speed, current, eco mode, panel lock.

widgets.label: Note
widgets.description: Operator guidance, procedures or limits written into the layout.

widgets.label: Panel
widgets.description: List of any channels and commands, like an instrument front panel.

widgets.label: Power Meter
widgets.description: Power meter card: watts, bus voltage, calibration, zero.

widgets.label: Pump
widgets.description: Metering pump or flow meter card: setpoint, flow, pressure, total, fluid select, zero.

widgets.label: Radio Link
widgets.description: Radio link card: link on/off with permit, transmit power, signal, packet loss, quality bar.

widgets.label: Range Sensor
widgets.description: Lidar or sonar card: emitter on/off with protection, range, signal strength.

widgets.label: Range Scan
widgets.description: Polar view of a lidar or sonar sweep. Bind a text channel holding a JSON list of ranges, spread evenly across the field of view.

widgets.label: Servo
widgets.description: Positioning servo: commanded position, travel limit, readback, park.

widgets.label: Setpoint
widgets.description: Drag or type a setpoint. Large adds fine steps and the readback.

widgets.label: Stat
widgets.description: One reading shown large, colored by its alarm limits.

widgets.label: Steps
widgets.description: Progress through the states of a mission or sequence, with the current one highlighted.

widgets.label: Toggle
widgets.description: Switch for an on/off output. Shows who last changed it.
